name: Lando Norris
background: Born in Bristol, UK, to a wealthy family, Lando dominated European karting and won the Formula 3 European Championship. He was scooped up by the McLaren Young Driver Programme and made his F1 debut with them in 2019.
accomplishments: Secured his maiden World Championship in a thrilling 2025 season. Known as the anchor that brought McLaren back to their winning ways.

name: Oscar Piastri
background: The Australian prodigy moved to the UK to pursue racing and achieved the incredibly rare feat of winning Formula Renault Eurocup, Formula 3, and Formula 2 in consecutive rookie seasons. He sat out 2022 before joining McLaren in 2023.
accomplishments: Won multiple races, secured a Sprint victory in his rookie season, and helped McLaren clinch the Constructors' Championship.

name: Charles Leclerc
background: Born in Monaco, Charles grew up deeply embedded in the motorsport world. A member of the Ferrari Driver Academy, he dominated F3 and F2 before making his F1 debut with Sauber in 2018.
accomplishments: Multiple Grand Prix winner, master of pole positions, and Ferrari's long-term team leader.

name: Lewis Hamilton
background: Raised in Stevenage, UK, with strong backing from his father. He was signed by McLaren at age 13. He made a shock move to Mercedes in 2013 and an even more shocking move to Ferrari for the 2025 season to fulfill a childhood dream.
accomplishments: Tied for the most World Championships (7) and holds the all-time F1 records for most wins and most pole positions.

name: Max Verstappen
background: Son of former F1 driver Jos Verstappen, Max was bred for racing from birth. He skipped lower formulas entirely to debut in F1 at age 17 with Toro Rosso before a mid-season promotion to Red Bull in 2016.
accomplishments: 4-time World Champion, breaking records for the most wins in a single season, and one of the most dominant drivers in the sport's history.

name: Isack Hadjar
background: A French-Algerian driver who climbed the ranks through the Red Bull Junior Team. After an impressive rookie season with Racing Bulls in 2025, including a surprise podium, he was promoted to the main Red Bull squad.
accomplishments: Scored a podium in his rookie year before securing one of the most highly pressured seats in F1 alongside Max Verstappen.

name: George Russell
background: A British talent backed by Mercedes. He won F3 and F2 before spending three years at the back of the grid with Williams, famously out-qualifying the car's potential, before finally stepping up to Mercedes in 2022.
accomplishments: Multiple race winner and the driver who finally took the reins at Mercedes following Lewis Hamilton's departure.

name: Kimi Antonelli
background: The Italian wonderkid. Backed by Mercedes since his early karting days, he skipped Formula 3 entirely to race in F2, and was fast-tracked into the Mercedes F1 seat for 2025 as Hamilton's successor.
accomplishments: Impressive rookie performances for Mercedes in 2025, securing his spot as the team's future star.

name: Fernando Alonso
background: Started karting at age 3 in Spain. He won his titles with Renault by dethroning Michael Schumacher. Known for making ruthless, sometimes controversial team moves and proving age is just a number.
accomplishments: 2-time World Champion, incredibly long career spanning over two decades, and considered one of the most complete drivers ever.

name: Lance Stroll
background: The son of billionaire Lawrence Stroll, Lance won the European F3 championship before making his debut with Williams. He moved to his father's team (now Aston Martin) in 2019.
accomplishments: Multiple podium finishes and a pole position in Turkey in 2020.

name: Pierre Gasly
background: A French driver who came through the Red Bull academy. After a brutal half-season demotion from Red Bull in 2019, he rebuilt his career at AlphaTauri before moving to the French national team, Alpine.
accomplishments: Achieved a stunning, emotional maiden victory at the 2020 Italian Grand Prix for AlphaTauri.

name: Franco Colapinto
background: Hailing from Argentina, Franco made a massive splash when he unexpectedly replaced Logan Sargeant mid-season at Williams in 2024. His immediate pace earned him a permanent seat with Alpine for 2026.
accomplishments: Brought Argentina back to the F1 grid and consistently scored points in his partial rookie season.

name: Esteban Ocon
background: Grew up in a modest family in France who sold their home to fund his karting career. A Mercedes junior who battled hard through the midfield before finding long-term stability with Alpine, and now Haas.
accomplishments: Won the chaotic 2021 Hungarian Grand Prix for Alpine, holding off Sebastian Vettel for his maiden win.

name: Oliver Bearman
background: A British Ferrari Driver Academy star. He made headlines worldwide in 2024 when he stepped in for an ill Carlos Sainz at Ferrari with just hours' notice, scoring points on debut. That secured his full-time promotion to Haas.
accomplishments: Scored F1 points on his debut in a Ferrari at age 18, cementing his status as a future star.

name: Liam Lawson
background: A highly-rated New Zealander in the Red Bull system. He impressed as a super-sub for an injured Daniel Ricciardo in 2023, scoring points in Singapore, and eventually earned his permanent seat.
accomplishments: Scored points on his debut stint as a substitute driver and solidified his spot in the Red Bull family.

name: Arvid Lindblad
background: A true teenage prodigy backed by Red Bull. After dominating the junior categories and winning multiple F2 races, he was fast-tracked straight into the 2026 Racing Bulls seat.
accomplishments: The true rookie of the 2026 season, stepping up to the big leagues as a highly touted Red Bull prospect.

name: Alexander Albon
background: A British-Thai driver who was dropped by the Red Bull academy, fought his way back in, got promoted to Red Bull, got dropped again, and then spectacularly revived his career by leading the rebuild at Williams.
accomplishments: Multiple podiums with Red Bull and single-handedly carried Williams to strong Constructors' finishes in recent years.

name: Carlos Sainz
background: Son of rallying legend Carlos Sainz Sr., Carlos is known for his immense technical feedback and race intelligence. He left Ferrari to make way for Lewis Hamilton, becoming the star signing for the Williams project.
accomplishments: Multiple Grand Prix winner and the only non-Red Bull driver to win a race during the dominant 2023 season.

name: Nico Hülkenberg
background: A German driver with an unmatched junior career. He spent years as the grid's ultimate super-sub before rebuilding his career at Haas, which earned him a factory drive with Audi's new F1 project.
accomplishments: Holds the record for the most F1 starts without a podium, but is widely respected as an incredible qualifier and reliable points-scorer.

name: Gabriel Bortoleto
background: A Brazilian star who won the F3 championship in his rookie year and immediately fought for the F2 title. Backed by Fernando Alonso's management company, he secured his seat alongside Hülkenberg.
accomplishments: Brought the Brazilian flag back to a full-time F1 seat and successfully transitioned the team from Sauber to the new Audi works entry.

name: Sergio Pérez
background: The Mexican veteran known for his incredible tire-saving ability. After leaving Red Bull, he brought his massive wealth of experience and sponsorship backing to lead the brand new American Cadillac F1 team.
accomplishments: Multiple race winner and played a legendary defensive role in helping Max Verstappen win the 2021 title.

name: Valtteri Bottas
background: A famously quick Finnish driver who spent five years as Lewis Hamilton's loyal wingman at Mercedes. After a stint at Sauber, he was brought in alongside Pérez to bring proven, winning experience to Cadillac.
accomplishments: 10-time Grand Prix winner and a crucial part of Mercedes winning 5 consecutive Constructors' Championships during his tenure.
